tooltip.createbattlebots.core: Your bot’s identity and knockout target. Right-click to inspect.
tooltip.createbattlebots.armor: Registered impact armor. Collapses when disabled and restores after the round.
tooltip.createbattlebots.relay: Emits redstone when disabled. Wire to a Create clutch to model drive or weapon failure.
screen.createbattlebots.human.hint: Operator: snapshot both bots and begin the human-piloted round.
screen.createbattlebots.autonomous.hint: Operator: start an autonomous round; human controls are locked.
screen.createbattlebots.stop.hint: Operator: stop the round and restore the registered machines.
screen.createbattlebots.recover.hint: Operator: retry restoration after a crash or failed verification.
screen.createbattlebots.status.hint: Show the arena, competitors, phase, time, and judges’ scores in chat.
screen.createbattlebots.help.hint: Show build, registration, arena, and repair instructions in chat.
screen.createbattlebots.surrender.hint: Concede your current round; both bots are restored.
screen.createbattlebots.operator_hint: A referee starts and manages each round.
